description:
Process finding from review: after the factory completed the connector backlog, the only way to assess health was manually running package tests one by one. That found failures in Cal.com, Jira, Linear, Salesforce, and a root compile warning. The Pi loop itself only enforces one clean commit per task; it does not yet provide a wave-level verification gate.

Why this matters: this repo now has many independently shippable connector packages. A task can be locally coherent while the broader connector family has dependency drift, warnings, or package test failures. We need a repeatable command that Mike/Codex/Pi can run after a factory loop finishes, and it should be documented in `pi-connector-factory` or a repo script.

Acceptance:
- Add a small verification command/script for the connector wave, preferably under `pi-connector-factory` or as a documented repo command.
- It should run package tests serially for at least: Cal.com, HubSpot, Airtable, Webhook, Jira, Linear, PostHog, Calendly, Salesforce.
- It should avoid parallel Mix build lock contention.
- It should print a concise pass/fail summary and return non-zero on any failed package.
- Document how this differs from `bun run loop` and when to run it.
- Include root compile/warnings check if and only if REVIEW-S01 has made that check reliable; otherwise document it as a known blocker.
title: [REVIEW-S07] Add connector-wave verification command
